# Thumbnail Maker

Thumbnail maker: eye-catching 16:9 YouTube thumbnails generated from your video title, with bold text on the image.

## What it does
Give the video title, the scene and a few words for the image. Claude tells you the price and creates a 16:9 thumbnail.

**How the files are made:** each thumbnail is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Image files; keep the text to two to five words.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install thumbnail-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Thumbnail Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/thumbnail/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each thumbnail uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The thumbnails show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_thumbnail_models` | Models for thumbnails with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_thumbnail_cost` | Exact price of one thumbnail before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_thumbnail` | Starts one thumbnail in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_thumbnail` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Thumbnail for 'I tried 30 coffees in 30 days', text: 30 COFFEES"
- "A shocked chef next to a giant burger, text: TOO BIG?"
- "A laptop with flames, text: DON'T DO THIS"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the thumbnail (the video title, the scene and the words for the image) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
